lane: H80-OTA orphan thermal alignment (collinear off-catalogue hot wells/springs)
status: preregistered before Experiment 1; label-free inputs only were inspected (point-file marginals, band tags)
hypothesis: Wells/springs with high chemical-geothermometer excess or high measured temperature that lie >1 km from every visible catalogue fault (orphans) are collinear along concealed, catalogue-missing geothermal conduit faults.
mechanism: Dedup GDR1391 points by cell (max weight). Tier A weight 2: finite dT=max(Tqtz,Tchalc,Tcat)-temp_c >= 30C and max geothermometer >= 90C. Tier B weight 1: temp_c >= 40C. Orphan = distance to VISIBLE catalogue > 10 px (holdout) or full catalogue > 10 px (final build). For each orphan point and 36 azimuths (0-175 deg, 5 deg steps), weighted support = sum of weights of other orphans with perpendicular distance <=2 px and |along-strike| in [5,40] px; vote = max over azimuths (own weight excluded). Splat each point's vote along its best azimuth +/-40 px with perpendicular Gaussian sigma 1.5 px -> ota_line. Channels: ota_vote_splat=ota_line rank, ota_x_ridge = sqrt(rank(ota_line)*rank(max(rank(band3 tmi_hg), rank(band5 iso_grav_slope)))), ota_orphan_prox = exp(-dist to nearest orphan/10), ota_hot_prox = exp(-dist to nearest tierA/B point regardless of orphan status/10). The csv dist_known_fault_px column is never read.
named_non_fault_mimic: Wells drilled along roads/canals/valley axes (anthropogenic collinearity) and regional aquifer flow along basin axes; mitigated by temperature/geothermometer weighting and the ridge-coincidence channel.

data.feature_stack: scripts/build_features.py (src/gems77/features77.py CHANNELS) -> data/processed/stack.npy, shared template stack, not forked

holdout.evaluator: vendor gems57.evaluate_holdout, version gems57-pooled-hide-v2, alpha 0.2 beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel
holdout.draw: gems57.holdout.buffered_component_draw(seed=30, hide_frac=0.20, buffer_px=3); whole components; every catalogue-derived quantity from fold visible only; visible faults masked pixel-exactly in scoring (evaluator masked_known)
holdout.emitter: gems77.emit77.emit_dots, budget 37654 pooled across folds pro-rata, min_sep 2.8 px, allowed = footprint & ~visible & dist_visible>2 px
holdout.model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=180, lr=0.09, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=40, random_state=77); per-fold training on other quadrants' visible positives (cap 40000) + 2x negatives (half 3<dist_cat<=15... dist to FULL catalogue used ONLY to define unlabelled negatives off any catalogue pixel with 3px buffer, identical to prior XSEN protocol; negatives exclude hidden by >3px catalogue distance to full catalogue which includes hidden - noted as protocol-consistent sampling, not a feature)

experiments_budget: Exp1: OTA fields from visible-orphans + single-feature leakage canaries (AUC>0.90 => stop) + surface-alone screens vs random
Exp2: paired HGB A_std vs A_ota pooled HOLDOUT-DTI + paired spatial-block bootstrap CI

Exp3: full-map build (orphans vs full catalogue), train on all catalogue positives, emit 37654 dots dist_cat>2, uniqueness vs checked subset (local TIFFs + restored scored witnesses + GEMSDOE32 champion if fetchable), validator, writer, run card
